review_text_raw: Jumpa Asa is an outstanding cafe in Jatinangor. The atmosphere is very comfortable and not very noisy. Unlike many other cafes in Jatinangor, this one has a good amount of indoor space with AC. The seats are comfortable for long work/study sessions. They even offer tables with sofas too. Almost every indoor table gets an outlet. And the tables are very clean and feels good to write on with paper. The food is also very good for the price, especially their snacks. And their coffee actually tastes quite good, unlike many other cafes who have mid-ahh coffee that only tastes good because of all the sugar and milk they add. You can get an espresso here for only Rp 12rb and it actually tastes good and not overly bitter. Only issue is parking. The parking area is quite cramped, typically only being able to park 2-3 cars while still leaving space for motorbike parking. Very good place to hangout or to study/work. A genuine gem in Jatinangor, compared to many other cafes here which only look good for Instagram stories.

review_text_raw: Tempatnya super clean dan didominasi warna biru putih yg eye catching. Ada area indoor yg adem buat kerja (WFCable banget karena banyak colokan!) dan area outdoor asri buat nongkrong sore. Highlight paling gemasnya..ada photobooth! Interiornya minimalis tapi tetap terasa warm dan kekinian. Aku coba varian choco hazelnut dengan topping cream di atasnya. Rasanya rich, ga terlalu manis, dan teksturnya velvety banget. Terus pesen matcha yg warnanya cantik, rasa earthy dari matchanya dapet banget dan ngeblend sempurna sama oat milknya. Visual wise? 10/10 for the gram! Aku pesan beberapa menu rice bowl mereka juga. Chicken crispy sambel matah dan crispy chicken nashville. Ayamnya juicy, porsinya pas, dan sambal matah dan saus nashvillenya fresh banget! Tahu cabe garam side dish wajib! Teksturnya garing diluar tapi lembut di dalam. Bumbunya meresap dan ga pelit. Pelayanannya ramah, tempatnya bersih, dan harganya masih sangat affordable buat kantong anak muda. Pasti bakal balik lagi sih buat work from cafe di sini. Highly recommended!

review_text_raw: Tempatnya memang tidak terlalu besar, tapi terasa nyaman dan asri. Konsep bangunan kayunya tertata rapi, sehingga suasana tetap terasa cozy dan cocok untuk ngobrol santai. Fasilitasnya juga cukup lengkap, ada mushola, toilet, dan area parkir yang memadai. Untuk makanannya, menurut saya worth it banget! Rasa dan kualitas makanannya enak, bukan sekadar asal disajikan, apalagi dengan harga yang relatif terjangkau. Cocok buat yang ingin makan di luar sambil menikmati suasana alam, tanpa harus mengorbankan rasa atau merogoh kocek terlalu dalam. Cuma, kalau kamu lagi pengen me-time atau cari tempat yang tenang, aku kurang rekomen sih karena di sini lumayan berisik.
